    function onloadIFrame()
    {
      //replaceAdditionalCodeDivId();
      processOnIFrameLoad();
      parent.addFootnotesToFootnoteList(frameId, pageDisplayedFootnotes);
			parent.showDivAdditionalCode(frameId);
      
      // If the ExpandAll is set to true, expand all the conditions and the export refunds.
      if('' == 'true' && parent.expandAllAllowed)
        expandAllIframeContent();
      
      top.highlightOnLoad();
    }
    
    function replaceAdditionalCodeDivId()
    {
      var divAddCod = document.getElementById("div_additional_code");
      divAddCod.id = "div_additional_code"+frameId;
      var divRedInd = document.getElementById("div_reduction_indicator");
      divRedInd.id = "div_reduction_indicator"+frameId;
    }
        
    function onunloadIFrame()
    {
      parent.addFootnotesToFootnoteList(frameId, new Array());
    }
    
    function getNumberOfAreaMeasures(area_code)
    {
     if(numberOfmeasuresByArea==null)
      return 0;
     for(var i=0; i<numberOfmeasuresByArea.length; i++)
     {
      if(numberOfmeasuresByArea[i][0] == area_code)
        return numberOfmeasuresByArea[i][1];
     }
    }
 
  </script>
